title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.10.11
body_markdown:
*released February 11th, 2025*

### What's New in this Release

* Fixed a bug in the optimizer that lead to incorrect codegen and was seen affecting the std::sort function when called from a coroutine.

### Security advisories addressed

* [**CVE-2025-21206**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-21206) Visual Studio Installer Elevation of Privilege - Uncontrolled Search Path Element allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.
